task_definition.task_name: Phase Picking with STA/LTA and AR Picker Branching

task_description.overview: Use classic STA/LTA to detect whether seismic events exist in waveform data. If an event is detected, apply AR-based phase picking (ar_pick) to determine P- and S-wave arrivals.
steps: Load and preprocess three-component seismic waveform data.
Apply classic STA/LTA algorithm to detect potential seismic events.
If STA/LTA detection indicates event presence, extract event windows from the waveform.
Apply ar_pick on detected event windows to pick P- and S-wave arrival times.
If no event is detected, skip phase picking for that waveform segment.
Save detected event windows and corresponding P- and S-phase picks into a CSV file.
Load reference phase picks and evaluate picking accuracy using residual thresholds (residual < {accept_residual_sec} seconds is considered correct).
Compute and save evaluation metrics including correct picks, missing picks, and false picks into a JSON file.
Plot waveform samples with detected P- and S-phase picks overlaid.
Plot residual distributions between detected picks and reference picks for P and S phases.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Perform seismic event detection and phase picking on the three-component dataset using classical methods. Load and normalize waveform data from {data_path}. 
 (1) Apply classical STA/LTA detection using window lengths {sta_window_sec} and {lta_window_sec}, with trigger threshold {trigger_threshold} and detrigger threshold {detrigger_threshold}, to determine whether seismic events exist. 
 (2) For detected event windows, apply `ar_pick` to pick P-wave and S-wave arrival times with given parameters {ar_picker_config}. Save the classification of the waveform, and picked results into a CSV file {result_data.file_name} with content {result_data.file_content}. 
 (3) Load target picks from {target_path} by reading columns `p_arrival_sample` and `s_arrival_sample`. Compute evaluation metrics between detected picks and target picks (residual < {accept_residual_sec} seconds is considered correct), and count missing and false picks. Save evaluation metrics into a JSON file {result_evaluation.file_name} with content {result_evaluation.file_content}. 
 (4) Plot the comparison between the predicted and target classification of the waveform, and save the figure to {result_figure.classification_comparison}. 
 (5) Plot the comparison between the predicted and target picks of the waveform (2x1 for ppicks and spicks), and save the figure to {result_figure.picks_comparison}.
